PORTAL_GROUPS.TITLE: Groups
PORTAL_GROUPS.DESCRIPTION: Customer groups are the audience of WhatsApp campaigns. A group joins whole companies and individual contacts. A whole company means all of its active contacts. Whoever is deactivated (company or contact) leaves the audience on its own.

CREATE.TITLE: New group
CREATE.SUCCESS: Group created. Now choose its companies and contacts.

DETAIL.AUTOMATIC_HINT: Automatic group: includes every active customer and cannot be edited.
DETAIL.ACTIVE_HINT: An inactive group does not appear in campaigns and receives nothing.
DETAIL.RECIPIENTS_TOTAL: No contact receives | 1 contact receives | {count} contacts receive
DETAIL.RECIPIENTS_HINT: Calculated by the Portal: active company, active contact, with a phone number.
DETAIL.ESTIMATE_HINT: Estimate from the companies and contacts chosen. Save to confirm.

EXCLUDED.NO_CHATWOOT_CONTACT: not registered in this Chatwoot account

SEARCH.LOADING: Loading the list of companies and contacts...
SEARCH.ERROR: Could not load the companies and contacts.
SEARCH.NO_MATCH: Nothing found, or it is already in the group.

COMPANY.TITLE: Companies ({count})
COMPANY.HINT: Whole company: all of its active contacts receive. A new contact of the company joins on its own, and an inactive contact shows as not receiving.
COMPANY.SEARCH: Add company (search by name or CNPJ)
COMPANY.EMPTY: No company in this group yet.

INDIVIDUAL.TITLE: Individual contacts ({count})
INDIVIDUAL.SEARCH: Search a contact by name, e-mail or phone
